theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)), ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) ∧ tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) ⊆ {x : Euclid N | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) : Euclid (N + 1)) ∈ tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1))}
